round_7.name: Registration currency only from the import licence and IL Append; rejected or void allocation requests never define a currency; incremental warehouse v2, stage 1
round_7.issue: Owner's case: the registration was shown in CNY with the same number as the EUR invoice. s59 took the registration value and currency from the credit proforma, else from the NTSW initial commitment, which carried the currency of the first (void) CNY request; the import licence and IL Append were never read. The NTSW classifier did not know «باطل شده» and treated a finished process as allocation, so the void CNY request counted as an allocation, and the rejected EUR request counted as demand.
round_7.fix: gsi/finance/registration.py: one reference order (import licence, IL Append latest amendment, credit proforma, PI sum as an estimate only) with basis, source, date, status and per-source conflict flags; one strict currency coder shared by s56, s59 and s70. NTSW: void, cancelled and expired requests are REJECTED, a finished process alone is CLOSED, the allocated amount comes only from allocated requests in their own currency, commitments are kept per currency. s56: rejected requests have their own event and column and are not demand; one registration event from the reference; evidence amounts carry their currency; the queue is dated from the first live request. s59: allocation, purchase, commitment and rejected-request currencies side by side with a CURRENCY_CHECK list, never merged. s20: CB_CURRENCY paired with CB_VALUE. s70: value at risk within one currency. Cashflow skips rejected requests. The trust rule compares SATA and customs invoice currencies only. Studio, HTML and Excel show the new columns and notes in Persian and English.
round_7.tests: tests/test_fx_currency_owner_case_v29_21.py (16 tests: the owner's case end to end on synthetic data, plus unit locks); tests/test_fx_rows_and_states_r7.py (10 tests: right row, not first or void row); tests/test_fx_currency_sums_r7.py (11 tests: no cross-currency sum); 2 new tests in tests/test_bl_registration_link_v29_16.py (unshipped upper bound, critical board row pairs); tests/test_warehouse_v2_history.py and tests/test_warehouse_v2_refresh.py for the warehouse. The second-sweep tests fail on the code before the fix and pass on this package. Two older tests that encoded the old behaviour were updated (NTSW commitment as registration value; open amount without currency).
round_7.warehouse_v2: Stage 1 of the incremental warehouse (owner decision 2026-09-28): WAL SQLite with a run sequence, content-addressed objects, a file ledger (unchanged files are not parsed again), source record history with a field-level change log, business tables versioned by content, no delete or edit (triggers), publish moves a pointer. round_7.second_sweep: 21 more same-family fixes (table rows 17-37 in docs/FX_CURRENCY_FIX_R7_FA.md). Right row, not first or void row: «آماده براي تخصيص» with a finished process is an open request (a regression the first fix of this round made, caught before delivery); the case status comes from the live request, the latest request status is kept apart; commitment deadlines from open rows; a void LC is not a registration value unless no other LC exists (flagged); FX 1405 file: the proforma rate and currency are kept apart from the purchase, duplicate lines are quarantined (DUPLICATE_LINE_SAME_RECORD) and a shared rial total is counted once; a planned purchase never fills the flat purchase fields. No cross-currency sum: Studio cards, summary, integrity, pivot and histogram per currency; one strict currency coder (unknown text is not a currency) in anomaly groups (nearest group by median), equivalents, experts, trust fitness and impact, warehouse measure totals (rejected, void or closed requests counted, not summed); cashflow takes the registration value from the licence reference (PI only as an estimate) and never sums an amount without a currency; the unshipped balance is flagged as an upper bound when part of the shipment has no comparable value; the critical board takes each amount with the currency of its own row and gives a multi-registration B/L no per-registration share; the risk penalty exposure divides only by a value in the penalty currency, else by the NTSW initial commitment.
